sourceOriginChain.derivationNote:
Issue #328: the MPFB2 materializer now derives its macro dict from the tracked Anny reference instead of baking the default human. age=0.6 from the measured head-height fraction (0.100, adult band); height=0.5827 SOLVED by bake-measure-interpolate so the baked+stripped exported body reaches the reference stature (1.76 m). Macros baked into the basis via TargetService.bake_targets immediately after create_human. #317 face keys (32 targets / 13 mouth), #318 helper strip (19,158->13,380 verts / 36,972->26,756 tris), #321 toigo t-shirt fit (2,700 tris, k-NN weighted to the standard rig) and #323 body-part hiding all ran unchanged. Measured (largest non-garment/non-hidden primitive): stature 1.6528 m, chest 0.9484, waist 1.1056, chest:waist ratio 0.8578. Regenerated 2026-08-11 (#337 resume): merged main (#335) and re-baked with CC0 MakeHuman default eyes (data/eyes/hm08/low-poly, header-verified CC0) fitted pre-#318-strip via HumanService.add_mhclo_asset(asset_type="eyes", material_type="PROCEDURAL_EYES"); eye mesh renamed makeclothes_library_eyes_low_poly_mpfb_<body>_mesh (96 verts / 172 tris), weighted 1.0 to eye.L/eye.R by interpolate_weights (dominant groups eye.L 48 / eye.R 48); #334 hide-mask head-joint bound and #335 casts preserved; iris rotation delta at gaze=1 measured 10-13 mm, 89-94% lateral. Issue #340: re-baked with the eye material consuming the asset's OWN declared .mhmat — brown.mhmat's diffuseTexture brown_eye.png (CC0, 610,817 bytes, git blob bda1b4b0 == upstream main) bound as glTF baseColorTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path; the flat eye baseColor (#337 white / #338 brown) is gone. Eye geometry (96 verts / 172 tris, eye.L/eye.R weights) unchanged; body macros, hide masks, garment fits, footwear and sole grounding re-run identically. textureMode updated procedural_fallback -> authored_or_baked because the eye channel now carries a baked diffuse texture. Issue #180 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the #180 palette + scrub wiring — materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now takes --actor-role and consumes automate_blender.garment_shell_color as-is (locked gown/scrub + closed_casual role fallback; no table copied). Nurse actor: upper garment is the CC-BY makehuman-community-scrub-shirt Scrub_Shirt.mhclo (max ref 11,018 < 13,380, fits the #318 stripped basemesh; ClothesService smoke fit ok, 4,688 verts / 9,384 tris) with the locked scrub colour (0.05, 0.48, 0.52); patient actors keep the CC0 toigo t-shirt with the closed_casual role palette (patient 0.72, 0.68, 0.55; family/parent 0.42, 0.36, 0.40); lower follows the same palette call. Post-fix the peds cast is pairwise distinct on upper AND lower base colours and the clinician's upper asset differs from the patients'. Footwear assets unchanged. Encounter-distance legibility is graded from the staged lit capture by the orchestrator. Issue #356 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the iris colour case-driven like the garment slot (#180). Pre-fix measured (mpfb-eye-colour/pre-fix.json): one byte-identical iris across the cast (sha256 4659691c7295ad62, 610,817 bytes, 1024^2 RGBA, factor (1,1,1)); baked brown, not greyscale (37% chromatic pixels, hue 34 deg). A licence-clear second asset exists: the official makehuman_system_assets CC0 pack (9 iris colours; every <colour>.mhmat carries the same in-file CC0 header as hm08; pack brown_eye.png byte-identical to the shipped iris; recorded in third-party-asset-licence-ledger.md). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now consumes automate_blender.eye_iris_colour(actor_role, phenotype) and resolves the declared colour id to its staged <colour>.mhmat in .openclinxr-local/provider-cache/eyes/makehuman-system-assets/ via the unchanged generic make_material_from_mhmat path (no table copied, no colour invented; baseColorFactor stays (1,1,1) — the texture is the whole appearance). This actor's iris: blue (pack, CC0). Issue #360 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the garment-texture wiring — the materializer now consumes each garment's OWN declared .mhmat diffuseTexture via the generic make_material_from_mhmat path (the #340/#356 eye path): patients' upper toigo t-shirt consumes T-shirt_basic.png and each footwear slot consumes its declared map (flats Shoe.png / mj MJ-shoes3.png / boots boot.png). The #180 role colour is preserved as the exported baseColorFactor (glTF factor x texture; the exporter drops the factor when a texture binds, so it is patched into the GLB post-export). Recorded skips keep flat colours: the scrub's declared Scrub_Shirt.mhmat and the cargo-pants' cargo_pants.mhmat are not staged in the provider cache, and the shipped lower cover shell carries no TEXCOORD_0 — a lower-garment texture is a fitting-pipeline slice, not this material slice. Issue #359 (2026-08-13): re-baked after the #360 merge with the scalp region as the shipped hair mechanism — the body mesh carries the bounds-derived openclinxr_mesh_native_scalp_hair_surface primitive (the Anny known-good mechanism; the #341 texture-mask hairline route is removed because the #358 head-framed comparison graded it as damage and it painted the front face band). Region per actor: aisha 2,364 tris (0.894-1.000 H), nurse 2,400 (0.898-1.000 H), child 2,008 (0.898-1.000 H); zero face-band vertices on all three. Garment textures from #360 are unchanged by this bake. Issue #343 (2026-08-13): re-baked with the shipped subsurface tint — apply_subsurface_tint loads MPFB2's data/textures/sss.png (CC0) and combines it with the DIFFUSE COLOR bake as a relative warm brightening (no light transport, no hand-authored node graph — the #343 RETRY approach 2). Skin atlas block-mean (16x16) luminance sd 1.39 -> 3.10 (this actor); dark-texel counterweight (0.35x median) clean; per-actor atlases stay byte-distinct. Issue #370 (2026-08-13): re-baked with a tangent-space normal map. bake_skin_normal_to_texture bakes the shipped enhanced_skin shader's perturbed surface normal (the Noise Texture -> ColorRamp -> Bump feeding the Principled Normal) to a glTF normalTexture via a Cycles NORMAL bake (geometry + bump, not light transport) and wires it through a Normal Map node. The base-colour atlas is byte-identical to the #343 bake; iris (#356) and garment (#360) textures unchanged.
Issue #199 (2026-08-14): re-baked with the LONG-SLEEVE upper slot. #197/#199 measured that body-surface-derived garments saturate at the elbow on the Anny rail (0 forearm verts by inverse-bind measurement), bounding every garment built that way; the MPFB rail has real forearm verts (122 on this body), so a long sleeve is achievable here. materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now fits the CC0 `toigo_fisherman_sweater` (shirts01 pack, `# license CC0` / `# author MRT` in its own .mhclo header, max basemesh ref 11,018 < 13,380 — same ref shape as the shipping t-shirt) as the nurse's upper, replacing the CC-BY Scrub_Shirt on this actor only (staging per SS8y: a nurse in long sleeves, not a patient). makeclothes_library_fisherman_sweater_mpfb_peds_nurse_kevin_mesh: 2,126 verts / 4,164 tris, k-NN weighted to the standard rig, locked scrub colour kept (cast stays pairwise distinct); the asset's OWN declared sweater_fisherman.mhmat -> shirt-knit.png is consumed as baseColorTexture via the #360 path (this slot now consumes a declared texture where the scrub recorded a skip). Bake-time licence re-read refuses the bake on AGPL/unspecified (the pack is MIXED: one AGPL3 garment inside the `_cc0` archive — extract by name only, ledger row). Measured on the shipped bytes: sleeve reaches t=0.971 along elbow->wrist, 4,164 skinned tris, 3/3 sampled forearm heights covered (a-long-sleeve-reaches-the-wrist-on-the-mpfb-rail REDs flipped). The lower cover shell's top follows the upper garment's hem, so the pants re-cut 2,628 -> 2,498 tris (flat-shaded baseline rebased #199). The boots slot now consumes its declared male_boots.mhmat -> boot.png (staged; the #360 record skip no longer applies to this actor). aisha/child unchanged.
Issue #386 (2026-08-14): the locked clinical colour and the authored garment texture multiplied. glTF multiplies baseColorFactor x baseColorTexture; the sweater's declared shirt-knit.png has mean luminance 0.206, so the locked scrub teal rendered at ~10% brightness (0.48 x 0.206) while the untextured cargo pants beside it (identical factor) rendered at the full colour — the control was already inside the file. materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now luminance-normalises every patch_factor=True (role-coloured) garment texture by its own mean (authoredMean 0.2057, scale 4.861, clamped to [0,1]; persisted to a per-bake temp PNG and rebound before export — the glTF exporter reads a FILE-sourced, non-dirty image from disk) so the factor sets the hue and brightness and the texture supplies only the weave (shipped texture mean 0.602, sd 0.434, above the evidence RED's 0.5 mean / 0.05 sd floors). The factor stays [0.05, 0.48, 0.52]; cargo pants and footwear (patch_factor=False, authored look) are untouched. This generalises to every future role-coloured garment that declares a .mhmat.

Issue #351 (2026-08-12): re-baked with the wrist/metacarpal limb vocabulary fix in body_param_stage._LIMB_BONE_RE (no-op on the mixamo_unity rail, which has neither bone). The lower cover shell's band selection wrapped the exported A-pose hands — this body's palms are metacarpal-dominant (177+177 outlying verts at |x| up to 0.547 m in the trouser top band) and the regex missed the MPFB standard rig's wrist/metacarpal bones — so the trousers shipped on the hands and the runtime clinical-idle pose wore the shards on the fingers. The widened vocabulary excludes the palm/wrist faces from the shell band; no trouser vertex is hand-weighted. Measured post-fix: lateral ratio 3.745 -> 1.261 (torso half 0.146 m, max |x| 0.184 m), outside-torso tris 306/3092 -> 91/2820 (all hip flare), leg area 5716 cm2, shirt/trouser overlap 17.8 mm unchanged.

Issue #377 (2026-08-13): re-baked with anatomically sized eyeballs. The fitted CC0 eye was 25-34% larger than human ocular axial length (fitted 32.05 mm vs 24.0 mm, least-squares sphere fit). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now shrinks each eye to the actor's anatomical target AND re-seats it forward (scale about the fitted sphere centre + translate so the corneal pole keeps its world z) — the naive shrink alone recedes the pole 3.0-4.0 mm and hollows the eyes. MPFB has no eye-size parameter to wire (set_scalings is a no-op), so this is a post-fit transform in the materializer. The eye.L/eye.R bones move with the globe so the gaze pivot stays at the new centre. The child's 22.5 mm target was checked against its phenotype (height_cm 125, school-age) and confirmed. Clauses of the eyeballs contract: diameter <= 1.15x anatomy (flipped to it), corneal pole within 1 mm of its previous forward z, sphere fit residual within 3x its own baseline.
